opening.argument: The warning signs lie in the cumulative pitch. The title calls this the easiest way for students to make money; the speaker promises good revenue from ideas implemented at home, gives a quick-payment anecdote, and describes the present as a particularly good time to grow on social platforms. The description also opens with shortened download and discounted purchase links. None of those elements alone proves a scam. Together, they invite a student seeking easy income to treat an unverified earnings example and a time-sensitive opportunity as reasons to follow the promoted path.
